outcome: Volume of prenatal visits using telehealth
cohort: Over 2500 women receiving prenatal care at a large academic medical center in Middle Tennessee, USA
finding: While telehealth use in prenatal care was prevalent, particularly in the second and third trimesters, disparities in utilization were observed among certain demographic groups, although no significant differences in preterm birth or Cesarean rates were found between telehealth users and non-users.
mod_finding: The study found no significant differences in preterm birth or Cesarean rates between patients who used telehealth during prenatal care and those who did not.
birth_weight: Newborn birthweight was measured as an outcome
